title: A Busy Morning in the City

sentences.text_target: Good morning, today is a very busy day for me.
sentences.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, təˈdeɪ ɪz ə ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi deɪ fɔːr miː/
sentences.text_native: Bonjour, aujourd'hui est une journée très chargée pour moi.

sentences.text_target: I check the weather forecast before leaving my hotel room.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ tʃɛk ðə ˈwɛðər ˈfɔːrkæst bɪˈfɔːr ˈliːvɪŋ maɪ hoʊˈtɛl ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Je consulte les prévisions météo avant de quitter ma chambre d'hôtel.

sentences.text_target: Unfortunately, I completely forget to take my umbrella.
sentences.phonetic: /ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, aɪ kəmˈpliːtli fərˈɡɛt tuː teɪk maɪ ʌmˈbrɛlə/
sentences.text_native: Malheureusement, j'oublie complètement de prendre mon parapluie.

sentences.text_target: Heavy rain starts falling immediately as I step outside.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi reɪn stɑːrts ˈfɔːlɪŋ ɪˈmiːdiətli æz aɪ stɛp ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Une forte pluie commence à tomber dès que je mets un pied dehors.

sentences.text_target: I button my warm coat and check my leather shoes.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈbʌtn maɪ wɔːrm koʊt ænd tʃɛk maɪ ˈlɛðər ʃuːz/
sentences.text_native: Je boutonne mon manteau chaud et vérifie mes chaussures en cuir.

sentences.text_target: A cold breeze blows through the busy avenue.
sentences.phonetic: /ə koʊld briːz bloʊz θruː ðə ˈbɪzi ˈævənuː/
sentences.text_native: Une brise fraîche souffle dans l'avenue animée.

sentences.text_target: My clothes quickly become wet because of the storm.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ kloʊðz ˈkwɪkli bɪˈkʌm wɛt bɪˈkɒz ɒv ðə stɔːrm/
sentences.text_native: Mes vêtements sont rapidement trempés à cause de la tempête.

sentences.text_target: I need to find an umbrella shop very fast.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tuː faɪnd ən ʌmˈbrɛlə ʃɒp ˈvɛri fɑːst/
sentences.text_native: Je dois trouver un magasin de parapluies très vite.

sentences.text_target: I walk past a bakery and smell fresh bread.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ wɔːk pɑːst ə ˈbeɪkəri ænd smɛl frɛʃ brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Je passe devant une boulangerie et sens l'odeur du pain frais.

sentences.text_target: I am a little hungry, but an important meeting waits for me.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ æm ə ˈlɪtl ˈhʌŋɡri, bʌt ən ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈmiːtɪŋ weɪts fɔːr miː/
sentences.text_native: J'ai un peu faim, mais une réunion importante m'attend.

sentences.text_target: I reach a busy street corner with heavy traffic.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ riːtʃ ə ˈbɪzi striːt ˈkɔːrnər wɪð ˈhɛvi ˈtræfɪk/
sentences.text_native: J'arrive à un coin de rue très fréquenté avec une circulation dense.

sentences.text_target: I stop at the traffic light near the pedestrian crossing.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ stɒp æt ðə ˈtræfɪk laɪt nɪər ðə pəˈdɛstriən ˈkrɒsɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Je m'arrête au feu tricolore près du passage piéton.

sentences.text_target: My smartphone battery is completely dead today.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsmɑːrtfoʊn ˈbætəri ɪz kəmˈpliːtli dɛd təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: La batterie de mon smartphone est complètement plate aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, I cannot check my digital map online.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðɛrˌfɔːr, aɪ ˈkænɒt tʃɛk maɪ ˈdɪdʒɪtəl mæp ˈɒnˌlaɪn/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, je ne peux pas consulter ma carte numérique en ligne.

sentences.text_target: I take a small paper notebook from my jacket pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ teɪk ə smɔːl ˈpeɪpər ˈnoʊtˌbʊk frɒm maɪ ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɒkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Je sors un petit carnet en papier de la poche de ma veste.

sentences.text_target: I hold a pen to read the written address clearly.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊld ə pɛn tuː riːd ðə ˈrɪtn əˈdrɛs ˈklɪrli/
sentences.text_native: Je tiens un stylo pour lire clairement l'adresse écrite.

sentences.text_target: I feel a bit worried because time passes quickly.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ fiːl ə bɪt ˈwʌrid bɪˈkɒz taɪm ˈpæsɪz ˈkwɪkli/
sentences.text_native: Je me sens un peu inquiet car le temps passe vite.

sentences.text_target: I need to ask someone for the correct direction.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tuː ɑːsk ˈsʌmwʌn fɔːr ðə kəˈrɛkt dɪˈrɛkʃən/
sentences.text_native: Je dois demander la bonne direction à quelqu'un.

sentences.text_target: I see a friendly tourist walking down the sidewalk.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ siː ə ˈfrɛndli ˈtʊrɪst ˈwɔːkɪŋ daʊn ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔːk/
sentences.text_native: Je vois un touriste sympathique qui marche sur le trottoir.

sentences.text_target: The smiling stranger stops near a large public building.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈsmaɪlɪŋ ˈstreɪndʒər stɒps nɪər ə lɑːrdʒ ˈpʌblɪk ˈbɪldɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: L'inconnu souriant s'arrête près d'un grand bâtiment public.

sentences.text_target: Excuse me, could you please help me find this office?
sentences.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, kʊd juː pliːz hɛlp miː faɪnd ðɪs ˈɒfɪs/
sentences.text_native: Excusez-moi, pourriez-vous m'aider à trouver ce bureau s'il vous plaît ?

sentences.text_target: The polite person looks at my schedule and nods.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə pəˈlaɪt ˈpɜːrsən lʊks æt maɪ ˈʃɛdjuːl ænd nɒdz/
sentences.text_native: La personne polie regarde mon programme et fait signe de la tête.

sentences.text_target: Walk straight for two minutes past the big museum.
sentences.phonetic: /wɔːk streɪt fɔːr tuː ˈmɪnɪts pɑːst ðə bɪɡ mjuˈziːəm/
sentences.text_native: Marchez tout droit pendant deux minutes en passant devant le grand musée.

sentences.text_target: Then turn left behind the old stone hospital.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn tɜːn lɛft bɪˈhaɪnd ði oʊld stoʊn ˈhɒspɪtəl/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, tournez à gauche derrière le vieux hôpital en pierre.

sentences.text_target: The bank is on the right next to the park.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bæŋk ɪz ɒn ðə raɪt nɛkst tuː ðə pɑːrk/
sentences.text_native: La banque est sur la droite, à côté du parc.

sentences.text_target: I thank him very much for his valuable help.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ θæŋk hɪm ˈvɛri mʌtʃ fɔːr hɪz ˈvæljuəbəl hɛlp/
sentences.text_native: Je le remercie chaleureusement pour son aide précieuse.

sentences.text_target: I follow his clear instructions quickly through the rain.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɒloʊ hɪz klɪr ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ˈkwɪkli θruː ðə reɪn/
sentences.text_native: Je suis rapidement ses instructions claires à travers la pluie.

sentences.text_target: Finally, I reach the correct door just in time.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, aɪ riːtʃ ðə kəˈrɛkt dɔːr dʒʌst ɪn taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Enfin, j'arrive devant la bonne porte juste à temps.

sentences.text_target: My safe arrival brings great success to my business day.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ seɪf əˈraɪvəl brɪŋz ɡreɪt səkˈsɛs tuː maɪ ˈbɪznəs deɪ/
sentences.text_native: Cette arrivée sans encombre augure un grand succès pour ma journée professionnelle.

sentences.text_target: Good preparation and polite questions solve every difficult problem.
sentences.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˌprɛpəˈreɪʃən ænd pəˈlaɪt ˈkwɛstʃənz sɒlv ˈɛvri ˈdɪfɪkəlt ˈprɒbləm/
sentences.text_native: Une bonne préparation et des questions polies permettent de résoudre tous les problèmes.
